integrity: Original 2-adic valuation formula and zero-defect classification are credited to their published source. The adjacent defect-one theorem has a self-contained proof and separately reproducible finite regression.
scientific_limitations: Classification only for Ω(n)≤2; no claim about Ω(n)≥3 or infinitude of Mersenne primes. The finite regression is not an infinite proof. Literature coverage remains incomplete and independent verification is absent.
title: The first binary valuation-defect layer for integers with at most two prime factors
